stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent 2.9.1 brings the light desktop much closer to the selected concept: header statistics, vector sidebar icons, one source-health strip, counted filter buttons, three-line vacancy rows with source marks and colored score/status pills, a native detail card with match checks and skill tags, and a run journal under the table. The full description expands inside the card. Source and extra status filters remain available in the filter menu; profile, updates, favorites, queue actions and letters are retained. Native labels render vacancy content as plain text; unknown-location cases show an explicit explanation. Scoring thresholds, search-only behavior and manual final Submit are unchanged. Verified with 33 offline tests, including real Qt widget actions and responsive layout, and render inspection at desktop and narrow widths.
